description: This file defines the 'ActivationRepartitioner' class which manages the distribution and migration of grain activations within an Orleans silo cluster. It handles exchange requests, computes migration candidates, and maintains state related to message sampling and edge weights for optimal partitioning.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: Handles the logic for repartitioning grain activations within an Orleans silo, including managing exchange requests, migration candidates, and maintaining message sampling state.

methods.name: ActivationRepartitioner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repartitioner with required dependencies and options.

methods.name: OnActiveStart
methods.description: Start processing when the silo becomes active, scheduling initial edges processing and timer setup.

methods.name: ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets message sampling counters and edge weights.

methods.name: TriggerExchangeRequest
methods.description: Initiates an exchange request with other silos, scheduling the next cycle.

methods.name: AcceptExchangeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming exchange requests from other silos, performing migratory logic.

methods.name: FinalizeProtocol
methods.description: Completes the migration protocol, deactivating grains and updating affected edges and anchored grains.

methods.name: CreateCandidateSets
methods.description: Creates sets of migration candidates for each silo based on collected migration edge data.

methods.name: GetCandidatesForSilo
methods.description: Filters migration candidates applicable to a specific silo.

methods.name: ComputeAnchoredGrains
methods.description: Determines grains that should be anchored due to migration imbalance considerations.

methods.name: GetMigrationCandidates
methods.description: Gathers and groups migration candidates based on vertex edges.

methods.name: CreateLocalVertexEdges
methods.description: Builds local vertex edges and their mirrored counterparts for migration analysis.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers the class as a parts of the silo lifecycle, starting and stopping processing as needed.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unsubscribes from silo status events.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications about silo status changes affecting message sampling.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Returns the frequency of grain call edges for analysis.
